references.text: Describes how the fat from the peace offering is to be removed and burned on the altar, following the same principle as in the sin offering.
Parallel instruction to remove the fat and burn it on the altar as a fire offering to the Lord.
The same procedure for the sin offering for the priest: the fat is to be lifted off and burned on the altar of burnt offering.
Identical wording regarding burning the fat on the altar in connection with a sin offering for a ruler.
Repeats the instruction to remove the fat and burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord.
Concluding parallel in the chapter concerning the burning of fat on the altar in connection with the sin offering.
Describes the fat that is to be offered in the guilt offering, burned on the altar by the priest.
Instruction to burn the fat on the altar during the consecration of priests, foundational for sacrificial practice.
